summary: List of community posts: gradient thumbnail with a label, clickable title, metadata row (author, duration, tags) and a vote box. Accepts an items array or PostListItem children; VoteButton is also exported on its own.
whenToUse: Feeds of trending posts or articles with community voting.
Compact content lists where the title is the main element.
VoteButton: voting on a question, idea or proposal.
whenNotToUse: A single featured article with cover and excerpt: use ArticleCard.
Numbered threads with replies and time: use DiscussionList.
Rankings of people with points: use Leaderboard.

props.name: items
props.description: Posts to display; alternatively pass PostListItem children.

props.name: onVote
props.description: Called when the vote of an items row changes.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: When set, titles become headings of that level.

props.name: variant
props.description: card: surface with border and radius; plain: only the dividers between rows.

props.name: PostListItem.thumb
props.description: Custom thumbnail content (image, icon) instead of thumbLabel.

props.name: PostListItem.onVoteChange
props.description: Vote change for the row (composed children).

props.name: VoteButton.count
props.description: Total votes, including the user's own when active.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Replaces the rows with a SkeletonList (aria-busy) while keeping the <ul> element and the frame.

inherits: PostList: HTML attributes of <ul>. PostListItem: attributes of <li>. VoteButton: React Aria ToggleButton props (isDisabled, autoFocus…).

keyboard.action: Moves from the title link to the row's vote, then to the next row.
Opens the post from the title link.

accessibility: Semantic <ul>/<li> list; name the list with aria-label or aria-labelledby when there is more than one.
The title link covers the row (stretched link); vote and tags stay on top and clickable.

VoteButton is a ToggleButton with aria-pressed; its name is “Vota” or “Rimuovi voto” and the description (aria-describedby) reports the full count (“186 voti”). The visible number uses compact notation.
The labeled thumbnail is decorative (aria-hidden); a custom thumbnail stays exposed, so give images an alt or make them decorative.
In forced-colors mode thumbnails and vote use system colors, and the active vote uses Highlight.
responsive: Container query: below 24rem the thumbnail is 48px with reduced spacing; the vote box stays at least 52 × 44px.
Metadata wraps; the title takes all the available space.
customization: Tokens: --dc-look-radius-container (list), --dc-look-radius-control (vote), --dc-color-action-primary, --dc-color-accent-default and --dc-color-data-1…6 for thumbnails, --dc-gradient-accent for the active vote.
commonMistakes: Passing isVoted without updating it in onVote: controlled state does not change on its own.
Expecting the count to change on its own: count/votes is always the total passed by the parent.
Putting important text only in the thumbnail: it is decorative.
